timing_definition.wall_ns: Original per-cell Pair duration, including setup, transfer and validation before final construction; not network RTT. Concurrent cell durations must not be summed as total run duration.
timing_definition.aggregate_application_payload_bytes_per_: (stdin_bytes + stdout_bytes + stderr_bytes) / (wall_ns / 1e9); 204800 bytes per successful observation. Excludes diagnostic prefix, protocol overhead and compression effects; not wire throughput.
timing_definition.retained_stderr: Successful captures retain 8241 bytes including a 49-byte stream prefix; Pair payload validation counts 8192 bytes.
timing_definition.cell_deadline: The 330-second ceiling is the shared absolute per-cell deadline (clipped by the overall deadline), covering startup and the whole capture; it is not a dedicated input-write timeout.
timing_definition.compression_requested: Derived from the pinned installed_streaming_cases::duplex source rule role <= server; not a measured field in the client-result artifacts.
